allow: PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'claude|node' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, Path | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match 'claude|anthropic|node'} | Select TaskName, State, TaskPath | Format-List; '---ACTIONS---'; Get-ScheduledTask | ForEach-Object { $t=$_; $_.Actions | ForEach-Object { $exe = "$\($_.Execute\) $\($_.Arguments\)"; if \($exe -match 'claude|anthropic|node'\) { "$\($t.TaskPath\)$\($t.TaskName\) [$\($t.State\)] -> $exe" } } })

PowerShell('--HKCU Run--'; Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run' | Format-List; '--HKLM Run--'; Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run' | Format-List; '--HKCU RunOnce--'; try { Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce' -ErrorAction Stop | Format-List } catch { 'none' }; '--Startup folder--'; Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup" -Force | Select Name; '--Common startup--'; Get-ChildItem "$env:ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\StartUp" -Force | Select Name)
PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'claude|node' } | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name, CreationDate, CommandLine | Format-List)

PowerShell('--pm2--'; try { pm2 ls 2>$null } catch { 'pm2 not installed or not on PATH' }; '--pm2 dir--'; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.pm2"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.pm2" | Select Name } else { 'no .pm2 dir' }; '--nssm/forever--'; foreach \($c in 'nssm','forever','node','pm2'\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { "$c -> $\($g.Source\)" } else { "$c not found" } }; '--services matching node/claude/pm2--'; Get-CimInstance Win32_Service | Where-Object { $_.PathName -match 'node|claude|pm2|nssm' } | Select Name, State, StartMode, PathName | Format-List)

PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'claude|node' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CreationDate, @{N='CmdLine';E={ if\($_.CommandLine\){ $_.CommandLine.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(200,$_.CommandLine.Length\)\) } }} | Format-List)
